reviewed_failed_checkpoint.failure_reason: Orion parent-directory inheritance retained the setgid bit after install -d -m 0700. The exact post-provisioning 0700 assertion failed closed before scheduler submission.
reviewed_failed_checkpoint.replacement_disposition: Preserve the exact empty inode. Commit, push, clean-worker validate and independently rereview the exact latest descriptor-relative helper patch, then run its explicit exact-empty inherited-setgid recovery option once. Do not delete or recreate the directory.

acceptance_root_helper_repair.default_behavior: The reusable primitive can create and normalize an absent unbound sibling root, but the production CLI binds the reviewed sibling identity and therefore rejects absence or replacement. Ordinary production pre-publication use verifies only the exact reviewed empty 0700 root without mutating it.
acceptance_root_helper_repair.recovery_behavior: With the explicit recovery option only, require the reviewed PIC-root identity and exact reviewed empty 02700 sibling inode with fixed uid, gid and xattrs, mutate the retained no-follow descriptor to 0700, revalidate identities and sync the child and parent.
acceptance_root_helper_repair.interrupted_recovery_behavior: A separate explicit reconciliation mode accepts only the same reviewed empty sibling inode already normalized to 0700, allowing canonical durable receipt publication after an interruption between fchmod and receipt publication. Recovery and reconciliation require an empty policy-side receipt-staging namespace before normalization; a retained pre-link orphan is a reviewed stop and must not be silently consumed.
acceptance_root_helper_repair.interrupted_receipt_publication_behavior: A separate explicit linked-receipt reconciliation mode accepts only the canonical read-only two-link receipt beneath the reviewed policy inode with exactly one matching retained .q011-acceptance-recovery.* staging alias, removes that alias, syncs receipt and policy descriptors, and requires single-link closure.
acceptance_root_helper_repair.immutable_helper_execution: Operational snippets extract helper bytes from the exact pushed Git commit bound to one completed clean repair-validation worker and one independent exact-latest-patch rereview, assert the reviewed fixed helper SHA-256 before execution, self-authenticate the extracted SHA-256, bind the reviewed PIC-root and policy-root identities, owner, group, modes and xattrs, re-attest the exact empty normalized sibling before and after every receipt operation, reject receipt ACL and unexpected-xattr drift, and publish or durably verify only a canonically validated read-only single-link recovery receipt through a retained policy-directory descriptor beneath the reviewed PIC-root descriptor.

first_required_human_input_after_automat: Select exactly one Section 5.4 problem/ps_p0 case from the verified immutable four-slice pressure-review packet.
